spaces.machine_glb: glTF Y-up right-handed, metres; used as-is in viewer
spaces.fig_local: STL local: +Y along body feet->head (0..0.739), -Z = figure forward (face/toes), +X = figure left
spaces.blender: Z-up right-handed; VRM armature in metres, T-pose, Hips at z~1.076 (Mira)

hands.note: hands at the two round console ports, figure-local Y~0.55, X +-(0.24..0.28), Z~ -0.36; world: see placement

buttocks.note: thigh/pelvis underside rests on platform edge near figure-local Y~0.30, Z~-0.26

pose_description: Kneeling, shins vertical on platform edge, knees forward (+Z fig-local), thighs angled up-back to pelvis; torso folded forward nearly horizontal (hip->neck drifts -Z), head lowered looking down-forward into console; both arms extended forward (-Z) slightly down into console ports; feet plantar on platform, toes pointing back (-Z fig-local = backward).

ik_targets.lfk_basis: VRM humanoid bones: hips, spine, chest, upperChest, neck, head, left/rightShoulder, left/rightUpperArm, left/rightLowerArm, left/rightHand, left/rightUpperLeg, left/rightLowerLeg, left/rightFoot, left/rightToes
ik_targets.method: Two-bone IK per limb in Blender pose mode using pole targets; spine chain FK; then bake to pose bones; export VRM with rest = current pose via VRM addon 'pose as rest' or matrix_basis bake.
